name: Russel Simmons
current_role: Co-founder and former CTO of Yelp
summary: Russel Simmons was an early PayPal software architect. In 2004 he co-founded Yelp with Jeremy Stoppelman at Max Levchin's incubator MRL Ventures and was its chief technology officer until June 2010.

timeline.role: Lead software architect (some sources call him a co-founder)

connections.name: Jeremy Stoppelman
connections.description: Former PayPal colleagues who co-founded Yelp at MRL Ventures in 2004; Simmons was CTO until 2010.

sources.title: Yelp co-founder and CTO Russel Simmons is out — TechCrunch
Yelp founders Jeremy Stoppelman and Russel Simmons — Commonwealth Club

connections.name: Max Levchin
connections.description: Levchin, their former PayPal colleague, founded the MRL Ventures incubator where Yelp started and provided $1 million in angel funding.

sources.title: The making of Max Levchin — Grainger College of Engineering, University of Illinois

source_conflicts.details: His Wikipedia entry calls him a PayPal co-founder and lead software architect; the PayPal Mafia article lists him as a former PayPal engineer.
